name: Shining Aria

any enemy on the field is Stunned

raw_4pc: When the equipper's Basic Attack hits an enemy, their Anomaly Proficiency increases by 36, lasting 8s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When any enemy on the field is Stunned, the equipper's DMG increases by 25% for 18s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

name: White Water Ballad

4pc_bonus.trigger: the equipper is within any [Ether Veil]

effect.condition: If the equipper is an Attack character

4pc_bonus.condition: If the equipper is an Attack character

If the equipper is an Attack character, activating an Ether Veil or extending an Ether Veil's duration increases their CRIT Rate by 10% and ATK by 10% for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

name: Moonlight Lullaby

trigger: the equipper is a Support character

effect.stat: the DMG dealt by all squad members

name: Dawn's Bloom
raw_4pc: Increases Basic Attack DMG by 20%. When equipped by an Attack character, using an EX Special Attack or Ultimate will further increase Basic Attack DMG by 20% for 25s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

name: King of the Summit

the equipper's CRIT Rate is more than

raw_4pc: When the equipper is a Stun character and uses an EX Special Attack or Chain Attack, increases CRIT DMG of all squad members by 15%, and when the equipper's CRIT Rate is more than or equal to 50%, further increases CRIT DMG by 15%, lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

name: Yunkui Tales
raw_4pc: When using EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, CRIT Rate increases by 4%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When having 3 stacks of this effect, Sheer DMG increases by 10%.

name: Phaethon's Melody

4pc_bonus.trigger: any squad member uses an EX Special Attack

effect.condition: If the character using the EX Special Attack is not the equipper

name: Shadow Harmony
raw_2pc: The DMG of Aftershocks and Dash Attacks is increased by 15%.

trigger: hitting an enemy with an Aftershock

effect.condition: if the DMG dealt aligns with the equipper's attribute

4pc_bonus.condition: if the DMG dealt aligns with the equipper's attribute

raw_4pc: Upon hitting an enemy with an Aftershock or Dash Attack, if the DMG dealt aligns with the equipper's attribute, the equipper gains 1 stack of a buff effect, at most once per use of a skill. For each stack, the equipper's ATK increases by 4%, and CRIT Rate increases by 4%. The effect can stack up to 3 times and lasts for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

name: Astral Voice

effect.condition: Whenever any squad member enters the field using a Quick Assist

raw_4pc: Whenever any squad member enters the field using a Quick Assist, all squad members gain 1 stack of Astral, up to a maximum of 3 stacks, and lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of Astral increases the DMG dealt by the character entering the field using a Quick Assist by 8%. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

raw_4pc: When Anomaly Mastery exceeds or equals 115 points, the equipper's CRIT DMG increases by 30%. When any squad member applies Freeze or triggers the Shatter effect on an enemy, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by 12%, lasting 15s.

name: Polar Metal
raw_4pc: Increase the DMG of Basic Attack and Dash Attack by 20%. When any squad member inflicts Freeze or Shatter, this effect increases by an additional 20% for 12s.

name: Thunder Metal
raw_4pc: As long as an enemy in combat is Shocked, the equipper's ATK is increased by 28%.
